# Switch 2 fw23.0.1 — console-attached dump catalog

Generated **2026-10-26 23:44** · repo `gitlab.com/nlightcho/ns2jb` @fb49425

Every non-game dump from the lab console, decrypted **on-console** via the
tethered-jailbreak loader routes (ldr:ro CodeFS / fs cmd 10 / owned root).
No keys included or needed — the loose decrypted form is the deliverable
(keyless-loader design). Game dumps are NOT in this catalog.

**Only original dumped bytes are cataloged** — derived artifacts
(Ghidra ELF wrappers, dumper-generated `meta.json`, report files) are
excluded from the hash tables and listed per section.

**Contents**

1. [BIS partitions (raw)](#1-bis-partitions-raw)
2. [Live fs sysmodule](#2-live-fs-sysmodule-live-memory-regions)
3. [System programs (87 titles)](#3-system-programs-87-titles)
4. [System data archives (57 titles, 39,052 files)](#4-system-data-archives-57-titles-39052-files)
5. [Full-BIS file trees](#5-full-bis-file-trees)
6. [Notes](#notes)

---

## 2. Live fs sysmodule (live-memory regions)

The boot-critical `fs` sysmodule (`0400000000000000`), read from **live
process memory** — it is package2-bound, never NCM-registered, so the
CodeFS route cannot see it. Execute-only text was flipped RX for the read
and restored after (kernel result 0). **11 region files**:

*Excluded (derived): `fs-live.elf` — analysis ELF reconstructed from these
regions (`fw-re/build-fs-elf.py`); `FSDUMP.md` — the method write-up.*

**Completeness — package2 modules:** the other boot-critical modules
(`loader`, `sm`, `pm`) are **not** live-dumped: like `fs` they are
package2-bound (never NCM-registered), and they exist decrypted only in
live process memory. Their encrypted package2 container **is** captured
(§1 raw boot partitions) — but package2 crypto keys are not in the scene
(T239/tsec RE — see `docs/research/PACKAGE2-CRYPTO.md`), so no decrypted
loose form exists for them. `fs` was the one live-dumpable module used
here.

## 3. System programs (87 of 90 NCM titles)

The **complete fw23.0.1 storage-3 inventory is 90 NCM titles**:
87 unpacked below + 3 meta-only stubs (see the
completeness block after the hash table). The boot-critical `fs` module
is NOT NCM-registered (package2-bound) — it is dumped from live memory
in §2.

Per title: **`text.bin` / `rodata.bin` / `data.bin`** (decrypted NSO section
images via CodeFS) + **`main.npdm`** (the module's real NPDM read from the
NCA). All paths relative to the dump root — `cd ~/dev/switch/dumps &&
sha256sum -c` compatible.

| TITLE | LEDGER STATUS | NCA CONTENT |
|---|---|---|
| `0400000000000837` | meta-only (no main module in CodeFS) | `6bd55be42d9e258f44b72ded76876a03` |

These registered a Program NCA but their CodeFS carries **no main

(Note: `FIRMWARE-DUMP.txt` says "88 titles" — its generator counted the
`elf/` placeholder row; the real count is 87 unpacked + these 3 stubs.
The 57 data archives are NOT storage-3 0x01 titles and are in §4.)

**GPU completeness:** the whole NVIDIA driver stack is among the 87 —
nvservices (0019, the nvdrv service surface), nvkernel (004f), ngc
(0050), vi2 (0063), host1x (0065), gc (0062), tsec (008d),
gsvm/gsv1/gsv3/gsv4 (0080/81/83/84), adraw (0072). The GPU
**microcode** (`fecs/gpccs/gpmu/acr/gsp` ucode) rides the nvservices
Program-NCA **RomFS**, which no current route opens (cmd 10 builds only
data readers; fs 206 type-1 needs the licensed-prelude context) — a
documented gap, route map in `FINDINGS.md` 2026-10-26 (3).

## 5. Full-BIS file trees

File-level copies of the **BIS 31 (SYSTEM)** and **BIS 30 (USER)** FAT
partitions (read-only, via the owned root — not raw partition images):

- `switch2-1u9ld7/system/` — 302 files, 541.5MiB
- `switch2-1u9ld7/user/` — 18 files, 4.3MiB

`dump-manifest.json` carries every file's sha256 + on-NAND allocation size
(sizes sum to 148GiB — NAND allocation, not local file size; on-disk
~616MB):

```
07bdcf9ace3d91a3921e4a69cd22253d0210db4534d6a02b5460511493c2d317  switch2-1u9ld7/dump-manifest.json
```

---

### Notes

- **Verification** — `cd ~/dev/switch/dumps && sha256sum -c <block>`; every
  hash above is the full file sha256 of the original dumped bytes.
- **Routes** — system programs via ldr:ro CodeFS; system archives via
  **fs cmd 10 fsType 6** (the 206 dispatcher mask-gates type-6 into the
  host flow — data archives are unreachable through 206 by design); live
  fs via rig `0x524f0016` bulk reads; BIS partitions via the owned root.
- **Not in this catalog (games)** — `~/dev/switch/roms/<title-id>/`
  (SmileBASIC `0100c9100b06a000`, TOTK `0100f2c0115b6000`, MKW-dev
  `0400c3f00006e000`) and `~/dev/ns2emu/reference/` deliverables.
- **Derived artifacts** (regenerable, not cataloged) — `fw23/elf/`,
  `fw23-live-fs/fs-live.elf`, per-title `meta.json`,
  `FIRMWARE-DUMP.txt` / `nca-structure.json` / `manifest.json` reports.
- **Provenance** — route history + decode write-ups: `FINDINGS.md` @fb49425.
- **Regenerate** — `python3 tools/dump/gen-dumps-catalog.py` (repo tool);
  `--check` verifies every hash against disk.
